interpretation.cpu: sum of maximum observed own-process user/system ticks per identity
interpretation.exit: evaluator exit, deadline, query coverage and result admission are independent
interpretation.io: per-process raw counters only; may include waited-for children
interpretation.omissions: short-lived or already-reparented unseen descendants and between-sample peaks may be missed
interpretation.peak: maximum recorded non-atomic sample, not actual job peak or PSS
interpretation.rss: approximate proc stat RSS; tree sums may double-count shared pages

scope: new controller descendants observed during query evaluation
